messages:
lina-ops: kicked off a targeted canary for driver 535.86 + fw 47.1 in us-west2-c (12 nodes) at 2026-03-15T09:12Z
canary-bot: deploy/canary-gpu-driver-535.86 started by @lina-ops
lina-ops: short findings: overall Xid rate down ~62% over 6h, but 2 nodes had bursts of ECC correctable errors during a kernel module rebuild window.
devin-sre: can you share the prom query + grafana link?
lina-ops: prom: sum(rate(gpu_xid_total{driver_version="535.86"}[15m])) by (instance)
grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/GPUSignals/canary-535-86?orgId=1&from=1647312000000&to=1647333600000
hao-infra: paste dmesg around the ECC spike times
lina-ops: dmesg:
```
[Mar 15 09:34:12] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00:00): 79, PID=14222
[Mar 15 09:34:13] nvidia: GPU 0: ecc: 45 correctable errors
[Mar 15 11:02:47] Kernel: nvidia_uvm: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel
```
lina-ops: uploaded full logs -> s3://redwood-telemetry/canary/1823456789.tar.gz
ryan-runtime: two of the nodes were on kernel 5.19.18, rest 5.19.22 — host update lag caused vermagic mismatch
devin-sre: mismatch + driver update can trigger module rebuilds and transient ECC counters. Rebuild modules against running kernel or homogenize kernels.
lina-ops: agreed. plan: quarantine the two nodes, reprovision to 5.19.22, rebuild, rerun smoke tests. ETA EOD.
oncall: set canary SLOs: Xid_rate < 1 / 5m ; ECC_corr < 5 / 5m. Auto-drain if exceeded.
hao-infra: propose smoke checklist:
- verify uname -r
- modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic
- gpu-burn synthetic loop (30s x 100)
- nvml sampling: nvidia-smi dmon -s u
- periodic dmesg capture
lina-ops: sample commands:
```
ssh node-03
uname -r
modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic
sudo systemctl stop kubelet && sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm && sudo modprobe nvidia
./gpu-burn -d 0 -t 60
```
ryan-runtime: add prom alert: ALERT CanaryDriver_XidSpike IF sum by(instance)(rate(gpu_xid_total{driver_version="535.86"}[5m])) > 2 FOR 2m
sara-platform: rollout gating: (1) 12-node canary, (2) 150-node regional mixed workload, (3) global roll 1% every 6h with auto-rollback
devin-sre: add vermagic mismatch detector to preflight to fail canary early
lina-ops: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 — preflight + vermagic checks
canary-bot: deploy/canary-gpu-driver-535.86 finished: 12 nodes validated, 2 nodes quarantined (job 8012)
hao-infra: next actions: reprovision 2 nodes -> run smoke checklist -> 24h telemetry capture. I'll own reprovision. ETA 4h.
sara-platform: need on-call for regional canary: infra/runtime/oncall. lina/ryan/devin covering.
devin-sre: rollback runbook snippet:
- sustained Xid > 5/min for 10m -> k8s deployment rollback + drain nodes
- ECC correctable > 200 in 30m -> mark node unsched + ticket HW replace
lina-ops: action items:
- hao: reprovision (ETA 4h)
- ryan: add prom alert & grafana gating (ETA 2h)
- devin: write rollback runbook (ETA 1h)
- lina: run 24h telemetry after reprovision
lina-ops: keeping thread open. :thumbsup:
canary-bot: created incident INC-2026-1387 for quarantined nodes
devin-sre: if homogeneous kernel + rebuilt modules still show Xid regressions escalate to vendor.
